---
title: "Bottlenose Dolphins of Sarasota Bay"
subtitle: "Nearly four decades of monthly sighting patterns along Florida's Gulf Coast"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

dolphins <- read_csv("data/sarasota_dolphins.csv") |>
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter (Dec–Feb)",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring (Mar–May)",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer (Jun–Aug)",
      TRUE                   ~ "Autumn (Sep–Nov)"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c(
        "Winter (Dec–Feb)",
        "Spring (Mar–May)",
        "Summer (Jun–Aug)",
        "Autumn (Sep–Nov)"
      ))
  )

fl_coast <- map_data("county", "florida")
```

Since 1970, the **Sarasota Dolphin Research Program (SDRP)** has conducted the world's longest-running study of a wild dolphin community. Drawing on **6,391 boat-based surveys** (recording **30,980 individual dolphin observations** from 1971 to 2009) alongside life-history findings from [Wells et al. (2025)](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2025.1531528/full), this site examines how Sarasota Bay's resident bottlenose dolphins (*Tursiops truncatus*) shift their group sizes and locations across the months of the year.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

ggplot() +
  # Draw nearby Florida counties for coastline context
  geom_polygon(
    data = fl_coast,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "#f0efe9",
    color = "#c7c4b8",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  # Plot all 6,391 dolphin sighting locations
  geom_point(
    data = dolphins,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = group_size, size = group_size),
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-82.95, -82.15), ylim = c(26.55, 27.68)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "mako",
    direction = -1,
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Pod Size"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(0.6, 3.5),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~season, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "6,391 Bottlenose Dolphin Sightings Around Sarasota Bay (1971–2009)",
    subtitle = "Sightings cluster inside protected bay waters year-round, with denser and larger pods in Summer and Autumn",
    x = "Longitude (°W)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)",
    caption = "Source: Sarasota Dolphin Research Program via OBIS-SEAMAP (Wells, Tyson & Allen, 2017)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#e6f2f8", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "#d4e6ef", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```
